landing.subtitle: With {{name}} you write the questions or let AI draft them, share a game PIN and play with everyone in real time. Made for lessons, trainings and events.
landing.howTitle: A live game in three steps

create.title: Create
create.text: Build a quiz in minutes with 8 question types, or generate one from a topic, PDF or web page with AI.
create.textNoAi: Build a quiz in minutes with 8 question types, import a spreadsheet, or let your AI assistant write one over MCP.

host.title: Host
host.text: Put the game screen on a projector. Players join from their phones with a PIN or QR code; no app to install.

play.title: Play
play.text: Players answer on their phones and the leaderboard updates after every question. A detailed report is ready when the game ends.

landing.featuresSubtitle: Built in the open by the community. Use it for free on this site or run it on your own server.

types.title: 8 question types
types.text: Quiz, multi-select, true/false, type answer, slider, ordering, polls and word clouds.

ai.title: AI question writer
ai.text: Generate quizzes from a topic, your notes, a PDF or a web page. Claude, OpenAI, OpenRouter or local Ollama.

mcp.title: MCP built in
mcp.text: Let assistants such as Claude or Cursor write a quiz and start a game. Pinpop supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

selfhost.title: One-command self-host
selfhost.text: Goes live with a single Docker command. No separate database server required.

realtime.title: Real-time at scale
realtime.text: Hundreds of players per game with instant updates and automatic reconnects.

reports.title: Reports & exports
reports.text: See who struggled where. Export results and quizzes as CSV or JSON.

opensource.title: Open source
opensource.text: AGPL-3.0 licensed. The source code is open for anyone to read and improve.

privacy.title: Privacy-friendly
privacy.text: No ads, no trackers. Players don't need accounts. Export or delete your data anytime.

i18n.title: Multilingual
i18n.text: Turkish and English included; more languages come from the community.

dark.title: Light & dark
dark.text: Easy to read on projectors, laptops and phones.

homework.title: Homework mode
homework.text: Share a link and let students play at their own pace. Results land in your reports.

landing.selfHostText: Pinpop ships as a single Docker image. It runs with PostgreSQL or with a built-in database that needs no setup.

selfHostPoints.one: Free and unlimited, with every feature included
selfHostPoints.two: Bring your own AI key or run a local model
selfHostPoints.three: REST API, OpenAPI docs and webhooks-friendly design

landing.selfHostNote: Then open http://localhost:3000. The first account becomes the admin.
landing.finalTitle: Create your first quiz in a few minutes.
landing.subtitleNoAi: With {{name}} you write the questions, share a game PIN and play with everyone in real time. Made for lessons, trainings and events.

import.description: Bring in a Pinpop JSON file or a spreadsheet saved as CSV.
import.csvHelp: One question per row. Columns: type, question, answer1–answer6, correct (answer number, e.g. 2 or 1,3), time, explanation.

discover.subtitle: Public quizzes made by the community. Play them or make them your own.
discover.emptyText: Try another search, or publish your own quiz as public.

detail.noQuestions: This quiz has no questions yet
detail.notFoundText: It may be private or it was deleted.

reports.subtitle: Results of every game you hosted.
reports.emptyText: Host a live game and the results will show up here.

profile.emailHint: Your email can't be changed here.
profile.darkModeHint: Easier on the eyes in low light.

ai.keepKey: A key is saved. Leave empty to keep it.

api.examplePrompt: Make a 10-question quiz about the solar system for 12-year-olds and start a Pinpop game.
api.restHint: Everything in Pinpop is available through a documented REST API. Authenticate with a token as a Bearer header.
